November 1st 2027

Today we set out once again to Nelsons Island. On our previous expedition to the island we had seen evidence of turtles laying eggs on the beaches. We have therefore decided to come back and explore further. We decided to stay overnight to see if we can see any baby turtles hatching. Before that, we went out on a diving expedition. Being seasick, I decided to stay on the boat while some of the team went diving. They were able to make some good observations of both Hawksbill and Leatherback Turtles. Unfortunately, we were unable to see any turtles being hatched. A small handful of our team have volunteered to keep coming every night to see if it happens. Still no progress on the mystery bird. We have now decided to head back towards Diego Garcia and study the atolls nearby.

November 14th 2027

Some interesting developments with the remains we have found. The team who had been working on Eagle Island had decided to do a little digging around the site where the original skeleton was found. They also found a second skeleton, not too far from the site of the first one. It appears that they are both the same species, however the second one seems a lot more complete. Meanwhile, my team had been able to study the ecology of the local coral reefs. We have been able to study the Chagos Clownfish. It was observed living amongst the Brain Coral, which is also common in Chagossian waters.

November 29th 2027

Today was the last day before a planned break over December. This would allow our researchers to return to their families for the holidays. We didn't really get much work done to be honest. We spent most of the day and night drinking and partying. The Hong Kong lot were as rowdy as ever, wearing full lab gear for the whole night. I'll just say we'll definitely have to wash them when return. Eventually most of the team went to bed around 01:00. They had to be up early to catch various flights home. It ended up just a few of us dotted around the room I'm small pockets. Someone had switched the music from the upbeat, fast paced modern music to some slower, old-fashioned classics. Anna and I were chatting in the corner when 'The time of my life' came in over the speakers. 'Oh my God, I love 'Dirty Dancing', it's one of my favourite films!'Anna said. I stood up and extended by arm towards her. 'Come on, nobody puts Baby in a corner'. She took my hand and I led her to the centre of the room. There we danced for what seemed like hours, just smiling into each other's eyes. By the time we finally sat down again, we were the only ones left in the room. I looked at my watch, it was 2:45. 'Shit, you better be going to bed. You've got to be up in a few hours to catch your flight'. 'I'm not going, I want to stay here and explore Mauritius with you' she replied, 'Although, I don't know where I can stay'. 'With me' I blurted out. She giggled at my clumsiness. 'Thanks Charles'. She smiled at me and gave me a kiss on the cheek. We kept talking until the sun came up, when we finally fell asleep in eachothers arms.

December 5th 2027

Anna had been staying at my house for nearly a week now. It had been quite awkward to explain ourselves to Hans when he had found us sleeping together, limbs all tangled on the couch in the cafeteria. We had said our embarassed goodbyes, before leaving ourselves heading towards Port Louis. Being the gentleman, I had let her have my bed, while I slept on the couch. We have already had an embarassing moment. It was around 10pm and I was going to bed. Out of force of habit I headed towards my bedroom. As soon as I opened the door I heard a shriek. In the middle of the room was a half naked Anna, barely covered by her towell. I stood there, eyes wide in shock. The realisation soon dawned upon me. She had just got out of the shower. As soon as I realised, I covered my eyes and backed quickly out of the room, swearing as I went. I heard a muffled laugh in the other side of the door, I joined in. That's when I decided to start knocking before I entered my room.

December 31st 2027

Me and Anna have had a wonderful December. We had visited many of the sights to see on Mauritius. The national park, the aquarium and even the sugar museum. We spent Christmas Day at my mothers house. My father had been Hindu, but my English mother had insisted on celebrating Christmas properly. We had a wonderful dinner and had a great time. It's New Years Eve today. We had both had a long night last night, so we had a sleep in this morning. We both got up in time to see the Royal Wedding. To say they were royalty, Prince Wenzel and Princess Alexandra both seemed quite normal. They made a great couple. I had special plans for tonight. We both knew the bars and clubs would be packed, so I came up with something else. Around 10:00pm, we set off towards the centre of town. Anna had been saying all month how she had wanted to see the Natural History Museum in Port Louis. There's something special about visiting a museum at night, the sense of history, the eerie silence and the echoes that reverberate around the room at any slight noise. I held in arms a six pack, a blanket and my trusty handheld radio. Usually the museum would be should at night, especially on a major holiday. However, as one of the leading biologists in Mauritius I had been given a key. We laid the blanket down in the main hall and turned on my radio. 'You're listening to Dodo FM the radio played before moving on to the latest Justin Bieber song. He had supprised me, even after his near death experience with an overdose of heroin and becoming a born again Christian, his new Christian Rock music had still managed to pull in millions of fan girls. Me and Anna talked for hours, sharing beers and wandering the exhibits. It was nearing midnight when we found ourselves back in the main hall. We sat down together, looking up at the glass ceiling. The sky was scattered with stars and the occasional premature firework. I was watching a rocket pass overhead when I noticed Anna staring at me. I turned to face her. Her blonde hair framed her face perfectly and her eyes sparkled in the light of the moon. She looked beautiful. 'Charles, we've known eachother for a long time. Ever since you arrived at my uni, I knew I would like you'. It's amazing how I ended up at Wagingen University. I was one of two agriculture students to be chosen to go as part of relations between Mauritius and the Netherlands. However, I found agriculture not for me and transferred to Biology, where I met Anna. We spent most of our time together, studying and partying, mostly partying! 'It's almost time for the countdown to the new year, stay right here on Dodo FM'. 'I never got a chance to tell you, you left for the Galapagos as soon as you graduated'. '10...9...'. 'Tell me what?'. '8....7....'. 'That I like you Charles, I always have done'. '6...5....'. 'Yeah, I know. You're my best friend'. '3...4...'. 'Not like that..'. She leant forwards, put her hands on my face and kissed me. '2....1! Happy New Year from Dodo FM!'. That sparked something in my brain. Thousands of thoughts passed through my mind in seconds. There was no way that this was real. It didn't feel real. I broke away from Anna's lips. I looked up and stared into the lifeless, empty eye socket of the skeleton that was in the background. 'I know what species our mystery bird is!'.
